name: CalendarScreen
label: Calendar
description: Calendar month/week/day views from any iCal/ICS feed (e.g. a Google Calendar secret address), with approaching-event reminders

settings.title: Enabled
settings.desc: Enable the Calendar screen and its reminder service

settings.title: Fetch Interval
settings.desc: How often to refresh calendar data (seconds, min 60)

settings.title: First Reminder (min before)
settings.desc: Minutes before an event to show the first alert (0 to disable)

settings.title: Second Reminder (min before)
settings.desc: Minutes before an event to show the second alert (0 to disable)

settings.title: Alert Timeout (min)
settings.desc: How long each reminder modal stays before auto-dismissing
